scope: From the seat of the home owner contracting a builder: which contracts Part 2 covers (s 3, r 2A: more than $7 500 and less than $500 000; not cost plus or sub-contracts); writing, date, signatures and the prescribed notice (ss 4, 5); the deposit cap of 6.5% (20% for off-site cabinetry, r 3A) and genuine progress payments (s 10); termination for the way the contract was made (ss 4(5), 10(4), 14(3), 19); cost plus contracts (s 14); variations and their exceptions (ss 7, 8); the building permit condition and its consequences (s 9, Sch 1 cll 1-3); the fixed price and price rises, with termination for a rise over 5% (s 13, Sch 1 cl 4); defects within 4 months of practical completion (s 11); inspection (s 26(2)); no contracting out (s 28); home indemnity insurance for a builder's work (ss 25A-25D: when required, the certificate before any payment, $200 000 minimum cover, $40 000 deposit cover, 6-year claim period, $500 excess); and the complaint time limits stated in the Notice for the Home Owner. Not encoded: unconscionable and misleading conduct (ss 15, 15A), prime cost items (s 12), transportable dwellings, s 20 adjustment beyond the right to complain, owner-builders (Part 3A Div 3), approved funds, the exemption-period notices (ss 25I-25L), offences, infringement notices and administration.
seat: the home owner contracting a builder
